question: What is the capital of France?

supporting_documents.text: The capital of France is Paris. Paris is located in the north-central part of the country on the Seine river.
The capital of Japan is Tokyo. Tokyo is located on the eastern coast of the island of Honshu.
The capital of Brazil is Brasilia. Brasilia is located in the interior of the country.

question: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?

supporting_documents.text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level. The boiling point of water decreases with altitude.
